subtitle: 1넴 투력·은신 허리띠 구경하다 돌무더기 압사 전멸 현장

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
오 ㄷㄷ 1넴한테
투력·은신 허리띠 떴어!!

In the lower-left foreground, the Gnome Rogue girl (blonde twin pigtails fading to hot-pink and electric-blue tips, green-lensed steampunk aviator goggles on forehead, black lowered chin mask, dark rogue cloak, green daggers sheathed neatly at her belt — Clean Hand Rule!) crouches eagerly pointing at the gleaming purple belt with huge starry eyes and an ecstatic grin. Across from her on the lower-right, the Tauren Druid girl (fluffy warm-brown plush cow hood with curved ivory horns and golden nose ring, leafy green mantle, gnarled wooden staff laid flat beside her) kneels leaning in excitedly with glowing amazed brown eyes and rosy cheeks; right behind them crouch two extra chibi party silhouettes (an Orc Warrior tank wearing a steel shield and a tiny hooded party extra) all staring down at the belt completely oblivious to tiny gray dust crumbs starting to trickle right above them! Keep all figures strictly in the lower two-thirds, fading seamlessly into 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white headroom across the entire top 38% (ZERO horizontal divider lines). Zero text, zero letters, zero UI.
